# Interviews {#interviews background-color="#f0674d"}

Eight transcripts, a codebook, and every quote checked.

## The folder {#folder}

- **Eight interviews** with founders who changed direction early. Fictional, and
  pseudonymised: F01 to F08.
- **The interview guide:** six questions.
- **Your own transcripts work the same way.** Only if your data plan allows it:
  what it reads is sent (*What it can touch*, Thursday).

## Is it really anonymous? {#try-anon .your-turn background-color="#f1c84b"}

1. Get it: the download prompt is in the handout, section 7. Then *"Set up git
   here and commit everything."*
2. ***"Read the transcripts. Is anything still identifying, even without the
   names? List it, with the file and line."***

[Pseudonymising by hand misses things. Here, three things slipped through.]{.small}

## A codebook first {#try-codebook .your-turn background-color="#f1c84b"}

::: {.prompt}
Read the interview guide and three transcripts. Propose a codebook: six to eight
codes, each with a definition and an example. Don't code anything yet.
:::

**Argue with it.** Merge two codes, split one, add the one you care about. Then:
*"Save it as coding/codebook.md and commit."*

## Code all eight {#try-code .your-turn background-color="#f1c84b"}

::: {.prompt}
Code all eight transcripts with the codebook. Save every coded excerpt in
coding/excerpts.csv: founder, line number, code, and the exact quote.
:::

::: {.prompt}
What are the three main themes? For each: which founders, and the two best
quotes. Save it as themes.md.
:::

## Every quote, checked {#try-check .your-turn background-color="#f1c84b"}

::: {.prompt}
Check every quote in themes.md and excerpts.csv against the transcripts, word for
word, with a script. List any that don't match exactly.
:::

[A script that compares text can't be charmed by a confident paraphrase.]{.punch}

## Then push {#push}

- *"Which founder doesn't fit the themes? What does that do to theme 1?"*
- *"Does anyone contradict themselves?"*
- *"Did they plan the change, or does it only look planned afterwards?"*
- *"What would a sceptical quantitative reviewer say about theme 2?"*

**Done early?** *"Make a table: founder by code, with counts. Which codes always
come together?"*

## Who does what {#split}

```{=html}
<div class="qa">
  <div><b>The agent</b><span>Reads eight interviews in a minute. Proposes codes. Finds every instance. Checks every quote, mechanically.</span></div>
  <div><b>You</b><span>Decide what a code means. Judge the themes. Own the interpretation, and the ethics.</span></div>
</div>
```

[Coding was the slow part. Now the slow part is thinking, which is the part you're
good at.]{.punch}
